Hemant N  hrinc1982@gmail.com  + 91- 8793176179 Pune

Objective Results-driven Lead Business Analyst with over 15+ years of experience in the BFSI domain. Adept at leading complex projects, facilitating digital transformation, and delivering strategic solutions across regulatory compliance, risk governance, and data management. Seeking to contribute expertise to a forward-thinking organization driving business excellence.

The value I deliver as a Senior Business Analyst Lead and mentor business teams in problem identification, current state assessment, and future state solutions. Provide strategic and tactical guidance throughout medium to high complexity projects. Utilize strong analytical and

project management skills to elicit business requirements and devise integrated solutions for digital transformation.

Expertise Area

BA Skills

Technical Skills

Domain Skills

Requirement

Elicitation(BRD,FRD,SRS)

Agile (User Stories) • User Acceptance Testing(UAT) • Project Management • SDLC Methodologies • SCRUM • KANBAN • Customer Management • Stakeholder Management • Customer Experience • Gap Analysis • Agile Methodology • Jira/Confluence • KPI Dashboards/Scorecards • RTM(Requirements Traceability Matrix)

Microsoft Office Suite • SQL • Prototyping and Wireframing • API Understanding • Microsoft PowerBI • MS-Visio, Balsamiq • Data Governance • Data Quality • Data Cataloguing • Data Lineage • AI Tools: ChatGpt, CoPiolot, NotebookLM, Wispr Flow AI, Google Stitch, Google AI Studio, Google Gemini, Claude AI, Julius AI, Comet, n8n.

Capital Markets • Derivatives • Mutual Funds • Equities & Bonds • Regulatory Compliance • FinTech • Commercial Banking • Retail Banking • Core Banking • Wealth Management • Digital Transformation • E-Commerce

Business Process Mapping

Prompt Engineering

(BPMN 2.0)

Experience

ABN Silvers Private Ltd, Kolhapur. - Freelance Business Analyst/ Business Operation Consultant Jan-2025 to Till Present

Reduced order processing turnaround time by 25% through business process optimization. • Improved SLA compliance from 92% to 99% by implementing KPI dashboards and proactive monitoring. • Reduced requirement-related defects by 30% through detailed BRDs, FRDs, and stakeholder validation

•

sessions. Increased UAT success rate to 98% by defining comprehensive acceptance criteria and test scenarios. Improved cross-functional delivery timelines by 20% through streamlined stakeholder communication and requirement management.

Reduced recurring operational incidents by 35% using Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and corrective action plans.

Delivered 15+ process improvement initiatives supporting Sales, Operations, Finance, and e-Commerce functions.

Managed stakeholder engagement across 4+ business functions (Sales, Operations, Finance, Technology) for successful project execution.

Gem Source IT Consultant, Hyderabad. - Lead Business Analyst Client: Infosys, Pune. |Barclays Investment Bank | May-2024 to July-2024 Domain: GRC (Governance, Risk & Control)

Spearheaded ORAC (Operational Risks & Control) data migration, ensuring 100% regulatory compliance and accurate transition of 2M+ records.

Conducted stakeholder interviews and workshops to gather and validate 50+ critical requirements. • Led root cause analysis, eliminating 90% of legacy data inconsistencies and streamlining risk control workflows.

Authored 40+ Epics and User Stories in JIRA, improving sprint planning efficiency by 30%. • Directed Agile ceremonies (SCRUM, KANBAN) and coordinated with 5 cross-functional teams, enhancing alignment by 25%.

Managed UAT planning and execution, achieving 98% defect-free deployment. • Secured approvals from 10+ departments (Legal, Cybersecurity, Operations) within timelines. • Developed data mapping and cleansing strategies, improving data quality by 40%. • Delivered SOPs and handover documentation, reducing BAU onboarding time by 50%. • Ensured 100% accuracy across 500K+ records migrated from legacy to modern platforms. • Managed scope, risks, and resources, completing the project 10% under budget. • Delivered weekly reports to senior leadership, enhancing transparency and trust. • Aligned migration workflows with GDPR and SOX regulatory standards.

Synechron Technologies Pvt. Ltd; Pune. - Lead Business Analyst Client: HSBC Bank, UK. | Oct 2021-May 2023 Domain: Capital Markets |Regulatory Reporting & Compliance

Led GDPR-compliant Cookies Duration Remediation for 20+ digital assets, eliminating 100% legal exposure.

• Created and refined user stories and acceptance criteria in JIRA, increasing delivery predictability by 35%. • • Oversaw stakeholder alignment and weekly communications, improving satisfaction by 20%. • Drove requirements lifecycle, delivering four consecutive quarters of 100% sprint goal achievement. Led As-Is/To-Be analysis, resulting in 20% improvement in user engagement. • • Reduced go-live defects by 30% through robust UAT planning and validation.

Implemented ObservePoint automation, reducing manual QA by 70%.

• • Provided input on banking solutions and supported GDPR/ePrivacy initiatives across 10+ LOBs. • Implemented Tealium EvenStream through the integration of GCP (Google Cloud Platform) to visualize Cookies Consent Report for various HSBC’s digital platforms.

Implemented 98% scan coverage and 100% SDK remediation for cookie compliance. Facilitated agile ceremonies and backlog refinement, improving velocity by 18%.

ABN Silvers Private Ltd, Kolhapur. - Freelance Business Analyst/ Business Operation Consultant Sept 2012 – August 2021

Reduced requirement clarification cycles by 30% through comprehensive BRD and functional specifications.

Improved UAT success rate to 98% by ensuring complete and traceable business requirements.

Achieved 100% SLA compliance through proactive monitoring and performance reviews. • Supported the successful delivery of 10+ cross-functional projects with zero critical post-production defects. • Reduced issue resolution turnaround time by 25% through effective stakeholder coordination. • Managed requirements for 5+ enterprise system integrations across e-Commerce, OMS, WMS, and Finance platforms.

AXA Business Services India Ltd, Pune - Business Analyst Client: Alliance Bernstein, USA | June 2008- July 2012 Domain: Capital Markets | Wealth Management | Treasury Operations

Led digital SMA account onboarding, reducing onboarding time by 60%. • • Automated AML/KYC validations, improving data accuracy and compliance. •

Implemented Portfolio Accounting Management Systems for the trust and non-trust accounts of Alliance Bernstein with impacted to various model portfolios.

Reduced discrepancies in $1M+ cash flows by 40% via reconciliation workflow improvements. • Collaborated with custodians and IA teams, increasing trade accuracy by 25%. • Authored 50+ user stories, Epics, and SOPs in JIRA & Confluence. • Achieved 100% UAT sign-off across 10+ modules. • Maintained 97% SLA adherence in reporting cycles. • Automated SMA account processes, cutting manual effort by 80% and processing time by 50%. • • • Ensured 99.5% accuracy in trade, reconciliation, and corporate action tracking. Supported MDM, data governance, and compliance with US regulations. Enhanced real-time data integration for Equities, FX, bonds, and derivatives to support portfolio management decisions.

Education

❖ M.B.A (Finance & Systems) from S.I.B.E.R, Kolhapur with 65% marks. (2007) ❖ B.C.S from Shivaji University, Kolhapur with 61.83% marks. (2004) ❖ 12th (Science) from Kolhapur Board with 65.33% marks. (2000) ❖ 10th from Kolhapur Board with 76.26% marks. (1997)

Certification

❖ Business Analysis Workshop – Mind Map IT Solutions (IIBA Endorsed)

❖ Financial Engineering – Torux Software (Grade A)

❖ Agile Scrum Training – Vinsys

❖ Capital Markets – Synechron Technologies

❖ Cross-Border Payments (SWIFT, ISO 20022) – Payments Guru Community

❖ AI Tools Workshop by be10X

❖ Project Management Assessment by Learntube
